parameters.name: hostname
parameters.explanation: 设备的主机名，用于标识网络中的设备。

set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.template: set interfaces [parameter1] unit [parameter2] family inet address [parameter3]/[parameter4]
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.command: set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family inet address 10.4.1.1/24
set interfaces ge-1/0/0 unit 0 family in.explanation: 配置接口的IPv4地址及子网掩码。

parameters.name: unit
parameters.explanation: 接口单元号，用于区分同一接口下的多个逻辑配置。

set routing-options autonomous-system 65.explanation: 配置设备的自治系统号。

parameters.name: autonomous-system
parameters.explanation: 设备的自治系统号，用于BGP等协议。

set protocols bgp group external type ex.command: set protocols bgp group external type external

set protocols bgp group external neighbo.template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] neighbor [parameter2] peer-as [parameter3]
set protocols bgp group external neighbo.command: set protocols bgp group external neighbor 10.4.1.2 peer-as 100
set protocols bgp group external neighbo.explanation: 配置BGP邻居及其自治系统号。

set protocols bgp group external family.template: set protocols bgp group [parameter1] family inet [parameter2]
set protocols bgp group external family.command: set protocols bgp group external family inet unicast

set protocols bgp group external export.command: set protocols bgp group external export redistribute-connected
set protocols bgp group external export.explanation: 配置BGP组导出指定的路由策略。

set policy-options policy-statement redi.template: set policy-options policy-statement [parameter1] term [parameter2] from protocol [parameter3]
set policy-options policy-statement redi.command: set policy-options policy-statement redistribute-connected term 1 from protocol direct
set policy-options policy-statement redi.explanation: 配置路由策略的匹配条件为直接连接的路由。

set policy-options policy-statement redi.command: set policy-options policy-statement redistribute-connected then accept
set policy-options policy-statement redi.explanation: 配置路由策略的动作为接受匹配的路由。
